description: No lexical veto or substring stance detection. Qwen interprets evidence under versioned scopes; Python validates IDs, facet membership, status/null/range/evidence and exact passage references. Semantic mapping is provisional, not guaranteed. Ambiguous mappings remain null/needs clarification.
duplicate_policy: One score per canonical concern. Shared evidence across concerns requires distinct facets/meanings and an explicit mapping note; simple residential routing is recorded as a condition, not a second infrastructure/visual score.
candidate_projection: An explicit supported/opposed/mixed medical-public-benefit dimension can nominate a missing welfare_equity medical_public_benefit facet for independent model review; it never assigns a numerical score or infers distributive equity.
